title: Takasago expands its Middle East presence with new Dubai Creative Centre
summary: On October 5, ahead of the Beautyworld Middle East trade show, Takasago officially inaugurated its new Creative Centre in Dubai, marking a further step in strengthening its presence in the region. The opening ceremony brought together several senior executives, including Paul Ireland, President of Takasago's Fragrance Division; Bassel Kouchacji, Managing Director of Fragrance Middle East; Frédéric Rivoire, Head of Fine Fragrance EMEA; Sylvain Eyraud, VP of Fine Fragrance Europe Sales, Global... - Industry buzz / Africa / Middle East
